title: Coconut Chicken Satay Bites
summary: Coconut and curry-powder chicken pieces, pan-fried off the skewer, with a mild peanut dip.

ingredients.name: chicken thighs
ingredients.note: boneless, skinless, cut into small pieces

steps.text: Mix {chicken} with {list:curry,sugar,paste} and a quarter of {coconut}, then leave to marinate.
steps.tip: Can marinate overnight in the fridge.

steps.text: Heat {oil} in a large non-stick pan and fry the chicken in batches until golden and cooked through.
Simmer the rest of the coconut milk with {list:pb,soy,vinegar} until smooth, adding water until it is a thick but pourable dip.
Cool {chicken} slightly and serve with any dip on the side.

toddlerTips: Skip skewers for toddlers; serve the pieces on a plate or cut them smaller.
Leave out the chopped peanuts that grown-up satay uses; smooth butter thinned in the sauce is safe.
Red curry paste is optional heat; leave it out the first time.

sources.title: Thai Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
sources.author: Nagi (RecipeTin Eats)
